item.content: {"url": "https://api.openalex.org/works?search=intrinsic+motivation+and+self-generated+goal+discovery+in+reinforcement+learning+agents&per-page=4&select=id%2Cdoi%2Ctitle%2Cpublication_year%2Ctype%2Ccited_by_count%2Copen_access%2Cprimary_location%2Cabstract_inverted_index", "scope": "OpenAlex scholarly metadata and reconstructed abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"id\": \"https://openalex.org/W2947638559\", \"doi\": \"https://doi.org/10.48550/arxiv.1810.06284\", \"title\": \"CURIOUS: Intrinsically Motivated Modular Multi-Goal Reinforcement Learning\", \"publication_year\": 2018, \"type\": \"preprint\", \"cited_by_count\": 105, \"open_access\": {\"is_oa\": true, \"oa_status\": \"green\", \"oa_url\": \"https://arxiv.org/pdf/1810.06284\", \"any_repository_has_fulltext\": true}, \"primary_location\": {\"id\": \"pmh:oai:arXiv.org:1810.06284\", \"doi\": null, \"is_oa\": true, \"landing_page_url\": \"http://arxiv.org/abs/1810.06284\", \"pdf_url\": \"https://arxiv.org/pdf/1810.06284\", \"source\": {\"id\": \"https://openalex.org/S4306400194\", \"display_name\": \"arXiv (Cornell University)\", \"issn_l\": \"2331-8422\", \"issn\": [\"2331-8422\"], \"is_oa\": true, \"is_in_doaj\": false, \"is_core\": false, \"listed_in\": [], \"host_organization\": \"https://openalex.org/I205783295\", \"host_organization_name\": \"Cornell University\", \"host_organization_lineage\": [\"https://openalex.org/I205783295\"], \"host_organization_lineage_names\": [], \"type\": \"repository\"}, \"license\": null, \"license_id\": null, \"version\": \"submittedVersion\", \"is_accepted\": false, \"is_published\": false, \"raw_source_name\": null, \"raw_type\": \"text\"}, \"abstract\": \"In open-ended environments, autonomous learning agents must set their own goals and build their own curriculum through an intrinsically motivated exploration.
